description.value: Phillips Brewing and Malting Co. is one of the few craft breweries in Canada that malts its own locally-sourced barley, giving their wide-ranging lineup of ales, lagers, sours, and spirits a distinctive farm-to-glass character. The tasting room and adjacent beer shop together offer a full house selection in a family-friendly setting with an outdoor backyard event space. Phillips actively sponsors local cycling events and causes, making it a particularly fitting stop for bike tourists rolling through central Victoria.
